changelog: Reliability layer. Every recalled answer now shows a grounding score so you can see how well it's backed by your own captured context, and a one-tap 👎 logs a correction locally. New opt-in 'Cloud second opinion' (Pro): when a local answer is weakly grounded, DensAssistant can quietly ask your cloud brain to double-check it — off the main path, with secrets stripped, and never replacing your local answer. Off by default; enable it under Settings → Cloud brain isolation.
